title: A second life for your Bose SoundTouch
hero_title:
SoundTouch, the way
it should have been.
hero_lead: New software for the Bose speaker you already own. AirPlay 2, Apple Home and multiroom with anything. No cloud, no account, no extra box.
hero_alt_light: The SoundTap web app on three phones, beside a SoundTouch 10 and a SoundTouch 300.
hero_alt_dark: The SoundTap web app on three phones in dark mode, beside a SoundTouch 10 and a SoundTouch 300.
airplay_text: Play from iPhone, iPad and Mac, straight to any SoundTouch.
home_text: Add your speaker to the Home app as an AirPlay speaker.
multiroom_text: Every speaker in sync, each at its own volume. A Raspberry Pi or any Snapcast player can join.
ha_text: MQTT out of the box: power, volume, presets and what’s playing.
music_text: Browse your NAS or media server, or push from BubbleUPnP and VLC.
cloud_title: No cloud. No account. No box.
cloud_text: The speaker runs on its own. Open soundtap.local on any phone and it works like an app.
updates_text: Signed, installed into a second slot, and only kept once they work. Bose stopped. SoundTap didn’t.
still_title: Everything you had is still there.
still_text: Your six presets and the buttons on the speaker. The remote. Internet radio and Spotify Connect. The alarm, the sleep timer and the SoundTouch 20’s clock. Bluetooth and AUX.
app_text: Every speaker serves the same app. Add it to your home screen. It speaks 25 languages, in light or dark.
screens_alt_light: Five screens of the SoundTap web app: Just for You, now playing, every room, your smart home, and your sound.
screens_alt_dark: Five screens of the SoundTap web app in dark mode: Just for You, now playing, every room, your smart home, and your sound.
shot_home_text: Your stations and music, one tap away.
shot_now_text: The song and its artwork, live.
shot_group_text: Group speakers, each at its own volume.
shot_smart_text: AirPlay, Apple Home, Spotify and MQTT.
shot_sound_text: Bass, treble and more, per speaker.
speakers_title: For the speaker you already own.
preview: And as a preview, the SoundTouch 30, Portable, SA-5 and more.
step1_text: On a computer or phone on the same Wi-Fi as the speaker.
step2_text: It shows only the steps for your model, in 25 languages.
step3_text: That’s it. Updates come from the speaker’s own page from then on.
alpha_text: SoundTap runs every day on the maintainer’s speakers. Its web page has no login yet, so use it on a network you trust.
